s.note: the loft before the baby turns up
s.how: Blitz 300g peeled green prawns with 1 egg white, 1 tsp ginger, 1 spring onion and a pinch of salt. Spread on 6 slices of white bread, press in 4 tbsp sesame seeds, cut into triangles and fry at 180C until golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

Slice 3 day-old bagels into thin rounds, brush with 2 tbsp olive oil and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp. Beat 250g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped chives and the zest of 1 lemon. Serve the chips around the schmear.

m.how: Cook 2 sliced brown onions in butter over low heat for 30 minutes. Sear 600g sirloin steak hard for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin. Mix 80g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp horseradish. Toast 8 slices sourdough, spread with the mayo, pile on steak and onions, lay 4 slices Swiss cheese on top and grill until melted.

w.how: Heat 500ml milk with a split vanilla bean until steaming. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 60g caster sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, pour on the hot milk, then return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick. Serve warm, or chill with plastic pressed on the surface.

d.note: the 3am feeds, test it on your wrist first
d.how: Shake 160ml bourbon, 400ml cold full cream milk, 40ml sugar syrup and half a tsp vanilla extract with ice for 15 seconds until frothy. Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses and grate nutmeg over the top. For a no-booze version, leave out the bourbon and add a spoon of honey.
